title: 68 Ventures Bowl History: Winners and MVPs - NewsBreak
text:
By College Football News ,
53 minutes ago It started as the GMAC Bowl, turned into the GoDaddy.com in the 2010s, became the Dollar General, and then the Lending Tree. Now it's the third year of the 68 Ventures Bowl.
It traditionally hasn't been a great game, with seven straight decided by double-digits. Last year's 38-31 Arkansas State win over Bowling Green stopped the slide.
Below is the history of the game, along with the MVPs.
